data.gender_notes: Kishn is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God of love, fertility, and protection
data.long_meaning: Kishn is a Hindu name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi languages, meaning the God of love, fertility, and protection. It is believed to be a name of Lord Vishnu, one of the major deities in Hinduism. The name Kishn carries the meaning “God of love, fertility, and protection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kishn usually hope their child will grow to embody god of love, fertility, and protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kishn represents love, compassion, and protection. It is a powerful name that invokes the blessings of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring prosperity and happiness in life.
data.etymology: Kishn belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of love, fertility, and protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kishn total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kishn holds cultural significance as a symbol of divine protection, love, and fertility in the Hindu community. It is often given to children as a mark of blessings from the gods. In mythological tales, Kishn is known to have slain evil demons and protected the virtue of dharma. Festivals such as Janmashtami and Raksha Bandhan celebrate the birth and love of Lord Kishn respectively.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kishn represents the endless love and compassion of God towards his creation. It serves as a constant reminder of the divine connection between an individual and the Universe. The name is said to bestow blessings of fertility, prosperity, and good fortune on the bearer. It serves as a source of inspiration and courage, guiding one through life's challenges and trials. In essence, the name Kishn represents the divine love, protection, and guidance of the Supreme Being.
